note: World recognition of rivals (Expanded Systems §5.1-5.3, §8.3-8.5; core/rivals/recognition.ts, protagonist.ts, signatureTeam.ts, rivalries.ts). Placeholders: {rival} (class and name), {other} (another rival), {badges}, {ace}, {title}. Lines are picked by hashing, never by gameplay RNG.
